name: Benchmark Camp
description_short: Five week summer program at Benchmark School in Media for rising 1st to 6th graders, built for bright kids with dyslexia, ADHD or other learning differences. Mornings mix small group reading, writing and executive function lessons with recreation; full day campers add afternoons of sports, swimming, art and a ropes course with a zipline.
special_needs_notes: Designed for children with dyslexia, ADHD, auditory processing or other learning differences. Language arts classes have up to nine students with a head teacher and an assistant; new campers get a reading assessment after registering for class placement.
notes: Full day 8:15 to 4:00, half day 8:15 to 12:15, or language arts only (8:15 to 10:00 or 10:30 to 12:15). After camp care 4:00 to 6:00. Full day campers bring lunch unless they buy the hot lunch program. No camp July 5, 2027. The pricing page says to check back in December for 2027 rates.
